topic.title: 架空の業務資料：保険金請求の確認

assets.label: 事故受付
assets.meaning: 建物の水漏れの申告を受け付け、被害状況を記録する。受付は支払決定を意味しない。
assets.subject: A small flat house facade with one leaking water droplet and a separate intake clipboard. No car or damage explosion.
avoid: Do not show an approved claim or payment outcome.
assets.semanticOrigin: Agent-designed visual representation of cited meaning

assets.label: 証憑照合
assets.meaning: 提出された領収書と請求明細を照合し、食い違いを担当者が確認する。
assets.subject: Two overlapping itemized receipts with a small magnifying glass inspecting their line items.
avoid: Do not show money paid, identical verified totals or a success check.
assets.semanticOrigin: Agent-designed visual representation of cited meaning

assets.label: 追加確認
assets.meaning: 証拠が不足した請求は追加資料を依頼し、確認が終わるまで保留する。
assets.subject: An incomplete evidence folder with a clearly empty outlined placeholder slot and a small question-mark speech bubble.
avoid: Do not turn a pending request into rejection or approval.
assets.semanticOrigin: Agent-designed visual representation of cited meaning

assets.label: 支払承認
assets.meaning: 担当者の確認後、別の承認者が支払を承認する。自動入金は描かない。
assets.subject: A payment instruction sheet held between two distinct flat approval-role stamps, with one small authorization check on the sheet.
avoid: No automatic transfer arrow, banknote rain or completed bank deposit.
assets.semanticOrigin: Agent-designed visual representation of cited meaning
